declaredBreaks.reason: Documents (beta, documents feature flag) can now be personal: a Document created without a Space is visible only to its creator and admins, and spaceUuid in Document responses and space in Document content items are null until it is moved into a Space. API clients reading these fields must handle null. Requests are unchanged except that spaceUuid becomes optional when creating a Document.
